title: Insert Mode Basics (i)
instruction_text:
Time to add text! Press 'i' to enter INSERT mode.

Your task: Add the word 'brown' to the sentence.

Current: "The quick fox jumps over the lazy dog."
Goal:    "The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog."

Steps:
1. Use 'l' to move cursor to the space after 'quick'
2. Press 'i' to enter insert mode
3. Type 'brown '
4. Press ESC to return to normal mode
5. Save and quit with :wq
setup_file: The quick fox jumps over the lazy dog.
target_content: The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog.
